intermediate.title: Red Bull KM | Muro del Ferro (132 km)

story: An intense start saw wave after wave of attacks before the breakaway finally took shape. Just before the first climb, Mikkel Bjerg opened a gap, with Jhonatan Narváez quickly bridging across before Andreas Leknessund joined them. Behind, a 30-rider break formed and split on the opening climb, while more riders jumped across from the peloton. Through the hilly middle section, Bjerg did much of the work at the front. With around 10 kilometres remaining, he dropped from the lead group, leaving Narváez to take control. The Ecuadorian attacked on the penultimate climb, distanced Leknessund, and rode solo to victory ahead of Leknessund and Tjøtta.
